## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.  
The new `--exclude` flag should honor `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` so CI jobs can set exclusions through the environment as project policy requires.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` flag that filters files by basename and logs skipped paths at INFO level. It also updates the flag documentation and adds tests and a text fixture.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Use `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` as the flag default — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` flag, the parser returns an empty list. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires each new flag to “take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that rely on `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` will archive files they configured the tool to skip. — Fix: Read the environment default when the flag is absent and extend `test_exclude_defaults_to_nothing`.
